context: Hina and Sho talk after school.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、学校、本当、楽しかった。
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Natural childhood enthusiasm — not performed. Slight breathlessness on 'really fun,' genuine warmth threaded throughout. Soft, unselfconscious delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、友達、本当、いっぱい。
lines.en: Yeah — and I made so many friends.
lines.style: Small, genuine smile in the voice. Quiet conviction. Soft warm tone. No performance, just a six-year-old's quiet satisfaction. Slightly breathy, content.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 一緒に、本当、頑張った、ね。
lines.en: We really tried hard together, didn't we?
lines.style: Eager, seeking confirmation. Bright childish energy. Slight lift on 'together' — proud of the shared effort. Warm, open delivery. Natural pause before the tag question.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: It was fun the whole time, wasn't it?
lines.style: Soft, reflective warmth. Small voice, big feeling. Stretches slightly on 'whole time' — savoring the memory. Genuine, unselfconscious. No rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Sincere, tender closing. Double emphasis lands softly — not for effect, but real feeling behind it. Slightly quieter. Open, unguarded. Warmth settles at the end.
